text:
Michael Misa's name has been in trade talk for weeks: reports have tied the 19-year-old to the Red Wings' Simon Edvinsson, and the Mercury News and San Jose Hockey Now both ran what he said about the rumors in mid-November. He's still a Shark, and San Jose keeps giving him more: his ice time over the last ten games is up more than three and a half minutes to about 17.

The second pick in 2025 has 4 goals and 12 points in 24 games, a fair rookie-year line next to the closest picks in our draft comparisons (Leo Carlsson had 0.53 points a game in his first full season, Matty Beniers 0.71). He's fast, with his bursts over 20 mph in the top 4% of the league.

The hard part is five on five. San Jose gets 38% of the expected goals with him on, about eight points worse than without him, and his linemates have finished about five goals above their chances, which has helped his point total. That's normal for a teenager on a rebuilding team. Watch the shot share, not the trade talk: it's what tells you how close he is.
